name: aspen-adaptive-generalization-loop
title_zh: 会自己长出新规则的 Aspen 通用流程模板
tagline_zh: 循环倍率一漂、撕裂流不收敛，你半夜重调的那几个旋钮，它替你写成 Calculator 和 Design Spec …
tagline_en: Recycle drift and torn-stream divergence at 2am: it converts your hand-tuned knobs into Calculator and Design.
desc_en: Build self-evolving Aspen Plus templates by tuning representative seed cases, converting manual knobs into Calculator, Design Spec, guard, inventory, root-selection, and classifier rules, batch-testing broad feed sets, and freezing evidence-backed generalized flowsheets. Use for Aspen biomass/syngas superstructures, recycle scale drift, ratio control, startup transients, multiple recycle roots, ga
why_zh: 不是给你一个调好的 bkp，而是把「为什么这么调」抽成规则：撕裂流选根、库存与比值控制。
why_en: It doesn't hand you a tuned .bkp; it extracts why it was tuned into rules — tear-stream root selection, inventory and ratio.
limit_zh: 只认 Aspen Plus 的稳态流程，动态、Aspen HYSYS 和别的模拟器都不管。
limit_en: Aspen Plus steady-state only — no dynamics, no HYSYS, no other simulators. You must supply the full feed range; it won't guess bounds. Frozen.
title_en: Aspen flowsheet templates that grow their own rules
